manifest.name: Pomodoro Desk
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: Adds a pomodoro timer to the header and counts completed sessions in plugin storage. Demonstrates ctx.h, ctx.api.storage, manifest.config (see the plugin settings panel), and teardownJs cleanup of timers.

css:
.plugin-pomodoro { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; margin-left: 12px; }
.plugin-pomodoro-time { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 700; }
